response.rationale: R5 is the only candidate with a pathognomonic raw biopsy span ('needle-shaped clefts within the lumen of a blood vessel') that directly confirms cholesterol crystal embolism. R3 (Atheroembolism) is the same disease but its raw spans are only nonspecific risk factors (PAD, prior AAA) and lack the diagnostic histology. R1 is actively contradicted by the raw span 'minimal perivascular inflammation', which argues against vasculitis. C1 is a redundant append-only completion of R5 and is discounted as a correlated restatement.

rejected.why: Raw spans are only nonspecific risk factors (PAD, prior AAA) and lack the pathognomonic biopsy finding of cholesterol clefts that R5 provides.
Actively contradicted by the raw span 'minimal perivascular inflammation', and its supporting spans (purpura, elevated CRP) are nonspecific.
Redundant append-only completion of R5; discounted as a correlated restatement of the parent candidate.
